# Getting started

*Start here · 1 of 34*

Take over the radio, pick a channel, talk.

## 1  Take over the radio

This app and the stock walkie-talkie app cannot share the radio. Open Device and tap Take over: the stock app is paused and its icon hidden until you tap Hand back. The app needs Magisk root to reach the radio's serial port; allow it when Magisk asks. If taking over fails partway, the stock app is switched back on, so the phone is never left without a working radio app.

## 2  Pick a channel

On the Intercom page the round arrows step through your channels. Or open Channels and tap a card, then Use. The first time (and whenever the list is empty when SignalDeck takes the radio) it asks whether to import your channels from the stock app; Start empty skips it and is remembered. Channels can be edited, added, backed up and restored.

## 3  Talk and listen

Hold the large round key, or the phone's side PTT button, to talk; release it to listen. The key is amber when idle, green while the radio hears someone and red while you transmit. SignalDeck ends a transmission at the transmit limit (Device → Longest transmission, 2 minutes unless you change it); past 30 seconds the heat guard also applies (Good to know → Transmitting legally → Time limit).

## The launch screen

When SignalDeck opens it shows its launch screen for about two and a half seconds, with the version number near the bottom, while the radio comes up behind it. Tap it to skip. Going back to the app while it is still open (launcher icon, recent apps, a notification) never shows it again; it plays only after the app was closed.

## 4  Hear more

Turn on SOFT SQ to hear weaker stations without static, TXT to read live captions of what is said, and SCAN to search the channels of a zone for activity. Each has its own topic in this guide.
